children: Dubai-based Metito Utilities, a global developer and operator of water and wastewater plants, said it has bagged the operation and maintenance (O&M) contract for the Dubai South sewage treatment plant from Dubai World Central Corporation.

Located in Dubai South, near Al Maktoum International Airport, the facility has a treatment capacity of 10,000 cubic meters per day. It uses membrane bioreactor technology with ceramic membranes to treat wastewater to Dubai Municipality standards, Metito said in a statement.

Under the contract, Metito will be responsible for the plant’s day-to-day operations and maintenance, including process control, performance optimisation, regulatory compliance and long-term asset reliability.
The deal's financial terms were not disclosed.
Dubai South is proceeding with its 2026 real estate plans with delivery commitments not contingent on short-term uncertainties, Group CEO Nabil Al Kindi told Zawya Projects in May.
He said the real estate sector in Dubai is supported by strong fundamentals, a clear government vision, and an investment proposition that has proven its resilience and appeal.
“Those foundations do not change with the current circumstances,” he said.

title: Metito bags O&M for Dubai South sewage treatment plant
